question: Is the exact scalar endpoint-mark lower bound from 081a5ed attainable: exactly two marks at width three and exactly three marks at width four?

state_space.ordinary: V_w is the rational span of circular noncrossing connectivity states
state_space.marks: Add k terminal scalar response states mu_r, r=1,...,k
state_space.filtration: The mark subspace is invariant; intertwiners and velocities may map ordinary states into marks but may not feed marks back into V_w.
state_space.no_more_cases: No other width or mark count is tested in this protocol.

mark_semantics.mark_r: mu_r is the r-th falling-factorial scalar endpoint response to the all-singleton column
mark_semantics.independence: The frozen marks are the first k falling-factorial block-count responses; no result-dependent rotation or free mark covector is allowed.

generic_Q_action.marked_detach: D_bar_i(Q) has ordinary block D_i(Q), mark block I_k, zero mark-to-ordinary block and ordinary-to-mark block (Q-1)E_i
generic_Q_action.first_jet: D_bar_i0=diag(D_i(1),I_k); D_bar_i1 has P_i in the ordinary block and E_i in the mark-by-ordinary block

gram.compatibility: For radical basis B require B^T(G_bar1 X0-X0^T G_bar1)B=0
gram.genuine_velocity: Report the exact rank of the k-by-dim(R_bar) mark-emission block D_bar_i1 B

normalization.endpoint: U=(one^T,0_marks) is fixed by X0 and annihilates V
normalization.sources: X0 fixes the all-singleton ordinary source and every mu_r; V kills them
normalization.mark_filtration: The ordinary components of X0 mu_r and V mu_r vanish

affine_jet.order_zero: X0 A_i0=B_i0 X0 for joins, translation and detach, with target site shifted by one

analysis_ladder: plus endpoint normalization and radical invariance
plus ordinary and all mark source normalizations

decision_rule.lower_bound_attained_unique: The final system is consistent with tangent dimension zero.
decision_rule.lower_bound_attained_nonunique: The final system is consistent with positive tangent dimension.
decision_rule.canonical_velocity: If nonempty, report whether the final affine space contains X0=T_bar,V=0 and whether V is uniquely zero.

if_still_empty.certificate: Give the first exact inconsistent restriction and a left-null witness y^T C=0 but y^T b=1.
if_still_empty.raised_bound: For a canonical restricted skew residual of rank 2r, report at least r further independent scalar endpoint marks and update the total-mark lower bound. Do not test that larger case.

deduplication.ba3135e: already excludes scalar loop fugacity without a marked response

claim_boundary: Exact rational Q=1 first-jet algebra only for the two frozen cases.
Marks retain only falling-factorial endpoint responses, not rooted-cluster geometry or arbitrary matrix degrees of freedom.
No continuum LCFT, physical transfer matrix or formal-semigroup K identification is made.
If the bound fails, only a new lower bound is reported; no additional mark count is tested.
